senses.definition: A trip, usually in a group and especially by students, to a place of special interest for education, research or exploration; a trip into the field.
senses.example: As I wrote we have a field trip scheduled (starting in about 1 hour to be exact since it's now 6 AM). We will take 72 of the second years to the coal mines, asbestos factory, steel mills in Enugu then up to Nnsuka.
